subject.title: feat: optional info lines (IP, uptime, OS, location) on the name tag

question: Should Nameplate accept macOS-only optional machine-fact lines now, with a shared core field contract but no Windows/Linux implementation in this pull request?
rationale: The repository documents cross-platform parity, while this user-facing feature and persisted setting are implemented only on macOS; code inspection cannot determine whether staged rollout is intended.

options.title: Accept staged macOS rollout
options.body: Merge after real macOS proof and treat the shared field identifiers and ordering as the contract for later Windows/Linux parity.

options.title: Require parity before merge
options.body: Hold the feature until Windows and Linux settings, rendering, and matching formatter vectors are included.

options.title: Keep the model macOS-local
options.body: Move the field model out of shared core until corresponding port work is ready.

recommendation.title: Accept staged macOS rollout
recommendation.body: Merge after real macOS proof and treat the shared field identifiers and ordering as the contract for later Windows/Linux parity.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the current overlay and settings architecture and is the strongest available owner for interpreting the repository’s parity policy.
